scripts.dev: pnpm run ensure:dev-built && concurrently -k -n electron,renderer "pnpm run dev:electron:run" "pnpm run dev:renderer"
scripts.dev:electron: pnpm run ensure:dev-built && wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:1420 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1420 electron dist-electron/electron/main.js
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run ensure:dev-built && concurrently -k -n host,renderer "pnpm run dev:web:host" "pnpm run dev:web:renderer"
scripts.build:app: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.dist: node scripts/materialize-oauth-env.mjs --ensure-for-packaging && node scripts/ensure-packaged-ripgrep.mjs && pnpm run build:app && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
